pages.text: Alcohol adds up and wears off over time: Merry, then Tipsy (the view sways), Drunk, and Smashed (slow, and the hiccups). Milk sobers you up at once.
Drunk or worse, you'll have a $(item)Hangover$() when you sober up: slower mining for a few minutes, shorter after good drinks. Water, milk, a hearty breakfast or $(item)aromatic bitters$() cure it.
